source_description: Cameranesi MM, Morán-Barrio J, Limansky AS, Repizo GD, Viale AM. Site-Specific Recombination at XerC/D Sites Mediates the Formation and Resolution of Plasmid Co-integrates Carrying a blaOXA-58- and TnaphA6-Resistance Module in Acinetobacter baumannii. Front Microbiol. 2018 Jan 26;9:66. DOI: 10.3389/fmicb.2018.00066. Table 2 lists 17 XerC/D-like sites on Ab242 plasmids (5 on pAb242_9, 4 on pAb242_12, 8 on pAb242_25). Sequences extracted from GenBank records KY984045.1, KY984046.1, and KY984047.1 at the coordinates reported in the paper (1-based indexing). C→D direction determined by comparison of forward and reverse-complement 28bp sequences against the Ab242 consensus (atTtcgtATAAggtgtaTTATgTtAaat). Orientations for sites 2,4,7,9,14 verified against Giacone et al. 2023 (Front Microbiol 14:1057608).
